title: Isothermal theorem of evolutionary graph theory (Lieberman-Hauert-Nowak 2005) in Lean 4
verdict_vs_prereg: Fixation statement proved (any initial configuration, single mutant at any node, uniform single mutant, neutral case). The preregistered phrase 'the number of mutants performs a birth-death chain' is false as a Markov statement (kernel-checked counterexample cycle4_not_lumpable); proved instead the per-configuration forward bias P+(S) = r P-(S) and harmonicity of moranFix n r |S| on configurations.
lean_stack: pinned Lean 4.34.1 + Mathlib d13f23b7 via scripts/certified_numerics/lean_pinned.py

main_theorems.EvoGraph.isothermal_fixation: 0<n, 0<r, Isothermal W (row and column sums 1, W>=0), StronglyConnected W => Tendsto (t => sPow (bdK 1 W r) t S univ) atTop (nhds (moranFix n r |S|))
main_theorems.EvoGraph.isothermal_fixation_single: r != 1 => single mutant at any v: limit (1 - r^-1)/(1 - r^-n)
main_theorems.EvoGraph.isothermal_fixation_uniform: r != 1 => (1/n) sum_v sPow t {v} univ -> (1 - r^-1)/(1 - r^-n)
main_theorems.EvoGraph.stationary_fixation: stationary selection mu W = mu, mu>0, cut positive => same Moran limit (Keller-Ugurlu 2024 Thm 3.1), and P^t(S, empty) -> 1 - moranFix
main_theorems.EvoGraph.forward_bias: stationary mu => upP S = r * downP S for every configuration S
main_theorems.EvoGraph.bd_fixation_mono: sPow (bdK mu W r) t S univ <= sPow (bdK mu W r) (t+1) S univ (limit = probability of ever fixing)
main_theorems.EvoGraph.two_absorbing_limit: P7 ProgPopGen.fixation_limit transported to any finite state space with two absorbing states (by conjugation, not re-proved)

positive.wellMixed_up/down: W_H = J/n: upP = moranUp n r |S|, downP = moranDown n r |S| for all n, S (exact lumping onto P7 Moran chain)
positive.starStationary_fixation: star n=3 with stationary mu=(1/2,1/4,1/4): limit from centre 4/7

negative.cycle4_not_lumpable: isothermal 4-cycle: upP {0,1} = 1/3, upP {0,2} = 2/3 at equal count 2 (count not strongly lumpable; holding chain); forward bias r holds at both
negative.identity_no_fixation: W = I isothermal, not connected: sPow t {0} univ = 0 for all t, no convergence to moranFix 2 2 1

controls.numerics: numerics_evograph.json (exact rationals): Moran on W_H n=3,4, cycle4, random doubly stochastic n=4; differs on star n=3 (avg 7/12), star n=4 (avg 728/1265 vs 8/15), random row-stochastic; star+stationary mu = 4/7; cycle4 (up,down) at {0,1} = (1/3,1/6), at {0,2} = (2/3,1/3)
